goal: Minimal frozen external-dynamics validation after the corrected final software batch. Validate N=64 TaskGraph-MSC against Uniform-global in AirSim without reopening algorithm development.
task: single moving target on a circular path; 64 tracker multirotors; truth-driven anisotropic noisy local observation adapter; fixed controller

smoke.purpose: integrity only: 65 vehicles, physical-clock closure, network accounting, and bounded-scope activation; no reward-based tuning

primary_external_consistency_rule: For the six paired held-out seeds, report paired 95% Student-t intervals. External consistency is supported if TaskGraph-MSC reward-gap CI upper <= 0.01 and serviced bit-hop saving CI lower > 0. This AirSim result is secondary external-validity evidence; the 12-seed corrected software batch remains the primary statistical evidence.
mechanism_checks: clock audit contains one valid 0.5-s physical advance for every control tick
TaskGraph-MSC has at least one scheduled hyperedge with selected recipient count < reachable recipient count
routine/critical fanout never exceeds frozen 32/48 caps
scope_decisions: Only N=64 is run because the AirSim purpose is to validate the scale at which bounded recipient hyperedges are active.

Only normal capacity is run because the corrected software experiment already establishes the low-bandwidth fidelity-scalability boundary; duplicating that stress grid in AirSim would add large runtime without changing the primary claim.

Pressure-global, Fixed-diverse-40, and Static-7/8 are omitted from AirSim because the corrected software batch already isolates those mechanisms. AirSim tests transfer of the frozen final method against the dense reference, not another ablation study.
No threshold, pressure, deadline, fanout, controller, seed, task, or capacity changes are allowed after inspecting held-out AirSim results.
estimated_runtime_note: Stage2 measured roughly 37 wall-clock minutes for one 160x0.5-s N=64 episode on the user's setup. The held-out matrix is therefore 12 episodes rather than the earlier 48-episode plan; plus two 40-step integrity smoke episodes.
